Thanks for sending the 12-month renewal draft. We want to avoid long legal loops. Can Redwood propose redlines that capture both the term cadence change and a billing schedule for the staged uplift? Happy to loop legal if needed.

Hi all —

Quick review from Legal: high-level OK to an 18-month term smoothing concept. A few legal notes (see inline PDF comments):

- We changed the proposed language to preserve Redwood's pro-rata termination rights on a per-period basis (Section 4.3). Aventis asked for a flat 18 months without proration; we recommend proration to avoid revenue recognition mismatches for short-cycle cancellations.
- For Exhibit B (staged uplift billing), we added a clause that ties the second tranche invoicing to an acceptance milestone (start of Q2) rather than a calendar date to be robust against implementation delays.
- Payment terms remain net 30; procurement requested net 45. If Aventis requires net 45 we need an exec approval for T&Cs impact on finance.

Logan — I left one optional alternative in the PDF (comment #7) that softens the acceptance milestone to a 30-day notice trigger if Aventis prefers simpler language.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
